<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.

Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation
Qwen3-30B-A3B with TP8/DCP2, Triton attention and BF16 KV can write DCP logical slot IDs directly into a rank-local KV buffer through fused RoPE + KV storage. This causes incorrect output and can produce CUDA illegal memory accesses as the cache allocation advances.
<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
`enable_fused_set_kv_buffer()` checks `forward_batch.dcp_kv_mask` to avoid DCP, but eager batch construction only populates that mask on HIP. CUDA batches can therefore have DCP enabled with a `None` mask.

Qwen3 MoE then selects fused RoPE storage, whose `FusedSetKVBufferArg.cache_loc` is the unchanged `out_cache_loc`, and skips the attention backend's KV store. That bypasses the Triton DCP path's owner mask and `loc // dcp_size` translation. 
- Reject the generic fused RoPE KV-store path when `get_parallel().dcp_enabled` is true. The existing attention backend performs the DCP-aware store.
- Add a regression to the existing gate test for CUDA/HIP, DCP1/2/4, and an absent batch mask. Keep DCP1 eligible for fusion.

## Accuracy Tests
- **All 1,319 official GSM8K test examples**, in dataset order.
- Qwen3-30B-A3B, complete real BF16 weights; 8 × NVIDIA A10; TP8/DCP2; Triton attention; BF16 KV;
- Chat API, 5-shot prompting, `enable_thinking=False`, temperature 0, `top_p=1`, `max_tokens=1024`, server seed 42.

Results:

| Metric | Main | Main + fix |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Correct / scored | 13 / 1,319 | 1,232 / 1,319 |
| Accuracy | **0.99%** | **93.40%** |


<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

@@ -156,5 +161,35 @@ def test_decode_context_parallel_mask_declines(self):

+class TestDcpFusedStoreGate(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_dcp_without_a_batch_mask_uses_the_backend_store(self):
+        pool = SimpleNamespace(
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            layer_router=SimpleNamespace(sub_pool=lambda name: None),
+        )
+        for cuda in (True, False):
+            for dcp_size in (1, 2, 4):
+                with (
+                    self.subTest(cuda=cuda, dcp_size=dcp_size),
+                    patch.object(model_utils, "_is_cuda", cuda),
+                    patch.object(model_utils, "_is_hip", not cuda),
+                    patch.object(model_utils, "is_cp_active", return_value=False),
+                    patch.object(
+                        model_utils, "get_token_to_kv_pool", return_value=pool
+                    ),
+                    patch.object(
+                        model_utils,
+                        "get_parallel",
+                        return_value=SimpleNamespace(dcp_enabled=dcp_size > 1),
+                    ),
+                ):
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        model_utils.enable_fused_set_kv_buffer(
+                            SimpleNamespace(dcp_kv_mask=None)
+                        ),
+                        dcp_size == 1,
+                    )
